prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual
Asset type: complete rasterized presentation slide
Primary request: create one polished 16:9 Chinese presentation slide for the role "cover".
Communication purpose: 建立主题和核心判断
Single claim: AI 原生知识工作流
Audience: 产品团队、知识工作者与组织管理者
Art direction: top-tier strategy consulting narrative with decisive hierarchy and evidence discipline
Composition/framing: answer-first headline, compact analytical structure, aligned evidence, clear comparison or process
Color palette: clean white, charcoal navy, deep teal, restrained coral signal
Typography: neutral professional Chinese sans serif optimized for fast scanning
Imagery: minimal analytical visual, credible business context, or precise information graphic. Page-specific visual brief: 城市、网络与知识流动形成的克制视觉意象
Material classification: image; use the matching visual representation and do not invent factual content.
Continuity anchor: data-consulting-anchor; continuity group: data-consulting-deck.
Materials/textures: crisp white canvas, fine gray rules, flat color signals
Theme consistency anchors: teal answer line; coral exception marker; structured source area
Text (verbatim, 文字必须逐字准确、顺序一致、每条只出现一次):
1. "AI 原生知识工作流"
2. "把散落信息变成持续可用的判断"
Constraints: render the complete slide as a single finished image; readable from a projector; strong hierarchy; generous whitespace; no editable UI; no watermark（无水印）; no logo.
Avoid: decorative photography; 3D charts; dashboard overload; marketing slogans; 不得添加任何其他文字; 乱码; 伪造数据; dense card grid; tiny labels.
